header.worktree: in-place branch: theme-consolidation-v1 (created from HEAD of dev in the main checkout)

interview_summary.problem: Theme code is scattered: tokens centralized in theme.css (OK), but theme JS is buried inside app.js, the theme list is hardcoded in 4 places, and the grid/status palette lives inline in base.html ignoring dark mode
interview_summary.expected_outcome: One central theme system: theme.css owns ALL tokens (incl. grid palette with dark variants), theme.js owns runtime theme switching, app.py owns the theme list registry, stale product build refreshed
interview_summary.constraints: Pre-paint boot script MUST stay inline in base.html (FOUC prevention, asserted by test tc111); tc139 asserts dashboard/filter/email logic stays in app.js; zero comments in code; app.js stays one IIFE for remaining non-theme logic
interview_summary.patterns: Existing ES5 IIFE style in app.js, CSS custom-property tokens in theme.css, context_processor injection pattern at src/app.py:187

user_decisions.detail: Extract theme JS, centralize theme list, make grid palette theme-aware with dark variants, update tests, rebuild product
Grid/monthly cell colors restyle with dark mode (user-approved visual change)
User said: create separate git branch, then we will work. Main src only in this plan; fix-watchlist mirroring is future separate work (ASSUMED interpretation - confirm at approval)

truth: src/static/theme.css (current token contract: 18 vars per theme)
dependencies: All 15 templates extend base.html (script tag change is global)
grid.html, payout.html, portfolio.html, share.html, add_position.html, payment_edit.html consume the moved palette tokens
scripts/build_product.sh copies src/ wholesale - rebuild picks up new files automatically
fix-watchlist/src holds identical copies - NOT touched in this plan (U3)

cascade_note: src/templates/base.html inline :root defines --muted, --border, --text which are ALREADY dead code: theme.css loads after the inline style and redefines all three (same :root specificity, later wins). Only 12 inline tokens are live: --page-bg, --card-bg, --white, --blue, --blue-light, --paid, --due, --danger, --ongoing, --completed, --current-month, --header-row. Phase 4 moves the live ones and drops the dead duplicates.
